text:
sam: quick heads-up — release cutoff is 2026-03-19 17:00 UTC. If your PR touches public APIs, docs, or console UX, please leave a changelog one-liner.
morgan: tiny Q — what's the preferred shape for one-liners? short sentence + component tag + PR link?
aleyna: yep. prefer: <component>: concise user-facing change (PR #).
morgan: can you give a concrete example? trying to avoid a dozen followups later
aleyna: sure — code block incoming:
```
console: show model latency in route details (PR #4321)
```
chris: rule of thumb: if a user or another engineer would notice it in the UI or SDK, add it. internal refactors/noise -> skip.
taylor: do we need to include migration steps for breaking changes in the one-liner? or put that in the PR body only?
aleyna: breaking changes: one-liner + a short parenthetical like "(breaking)" and link to a migration doc in the PR body. example: `sdk: rename fetch() -> request() (breaking, see PR #1234)`
release-bot: Reminder: automatic changelog collation runs 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC. Entries after cutoff may be dropped from this release.
devex: tiny formatting notes: 1) use lowercase component prefix (sdk, console, infra), 2) keep to one short sentence, 3) add PR number in parentheses. Avoid long bulleted text in the one-liner.
morgan: if someone isn't sure which component to pick, what then?
devex: pick the closest visible surface (e.g., 'console' for UI, 'api' for HTTP surface). If truly unsure, use 'misc' and we'll triage during collation.
sam: branch coordination: if you have a backport/patch to a stable branch, add a separate changelog entry and tag it with the branch name in the PR description (e.g., `backport/rc-1.4`). we'll include both in the release notes.
chris: one small ask — please don't list internal switchovers like "rename var x". If it changes behavior or error text, then include it.
taylor: can we get a tiny checklist to paste in PR templates? saves time for reviewers.
aleyna: pasted template below — feel free to copy into PR body:
```
Changelog entry: component: short one-line description (PR #)
Migration: link to doc or note (if breaking)
Release owner: @<team-member> (optional)
```
morgan: this is great — will add to my open PR now. thanks!
sam: thanks all — assigning release check to @taylor and @chris to triage any ambiguous entries during collation. ping me if you need help. :thumbsup:
